source_detail: Built in ca-tools 2026-11-11 in two steps, both run by programs/recipe.sh. Step 1, profile product (method of Colbourn and Torres-Jimenez 2013, Thm 4.2 / Cor 4.5, programs/pprod.py) of the table's CA(18; 2, 52, 3) (submission smolen-2026-11-t2v3-z3z3-18rows, rows 0 and 1, which agree in 13 columns) with the table's own CA(11; 2, 5, 3) (CA_11_2_5_3_c33e3aff, rows 0 and 4, which agree in 1 column). The product has 18 + 11 - 3 = 26 rows and 52 x 5 - 13 x 1 = 247 columns. No search in this step. Step 2, column extension at 26 rows with programs/ext2t.c, one column at a time, each new column the best of 200 random columns, then simulated annealing with exact pair counts in which only the new column may change (temperature 0.7, seed 13), and a stuck column redrawn after 200000 moves. The array saved at 296 columns (move 125,556,965 of the run) is the array here, and the first 247 columns are exactly the product. Exact check with ca_verify, all column pairs
